_about: Hidden Windows display set-up (Lineage11, owner's ruling 2026-11-24: the default platform is Windows). Run first by every example of chapters 10 and 11: pathlib.Path shows the Windows form (C: drive, backslashes, WindowsPath) while files stay on the real system. as_posix() and as_uri() keep the real system form so that the library functions that use it still find the files.
